question: Do FY2013-FY2015 official annual reports continuously disclose whole-issuer beer production volume, sell-through or capacity utilization distinct from sales volume?

source_findings.sales_volume: 98.95 ten-thousand kl in the recurring annual headline; 102.70 ten-thousand kl in the product table including 3.75 ten-thousand kl commissioned processing
source_findings.production_volume: 88.77 ten-thousand kl in the product table
source_findings.production_volume_change: minus 6 percent year on year, rounded

single_plant_evidence.observation: The FY2015 report states a future Yibin relocation design capacity commitment.
single_plant_evidence.reason: It is a future single-plant design target, not realized consolidated production or utilization.

prohibited_conversions: copy annual sales volume into a production-volume predicate
treat product-table sales volume as production volume
derive an exact FY2014 production value from FY2015's rounded minus-6-percent change
use the Yibin plant design commitment as whole-issuer capacity utilization

effect_on_current_freeze.D2: Annual headline sales volume remains observable as customer absorption context.
effect_on_current_freeze.D3: Whole-issuer operating-contribution amount remains observable without a product-volume denominator, but it is a downstream unit-economics result and cannot isolate plant throughput or fixed-cost absorption.
effect_on_current_freeze.hard_gate_rule: The current product contract requires the five D1-D5 layers and makes D3_PRODUCT_VOLUME optional. Retain production throughput as UNKNOWN and non-voting, do not register a product-volume claim, and prohibit causal attribution of D3 changes to utilization alone.

outcome_firewall_attestation: This audit searched only the already acquired FY2013-FY2015 official annual-report texts. No post-cutoff title, filename, snippet, body, result, security price, valuation or return was accessed.
